Anil Kumar Rathaur And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.
Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 18 August, 2023

Author: Rajeev Singh
Bench: Rajeev Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:55016
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 909 of 2023
Revisionist :- Anil Kumar Rathaur And 4 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Home And Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- Shiv Shankar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the revisionist and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2.  The present revision is filed with the prayer to quash the order dated 12.6.2023 passed by learned A.C.J.M.-6, Court No.30, Lucknow in Case No.29867 of 2018 arising out of Case Crime No.1089/2017 under Section 420 I.PC. Police Station Kakori, Lucknow and discharge the revisionist from the allegation levelled against them.

3. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that revisionists were falsely implicated in the present case as they are trained paravet and they were being engaged time to time by the officers of Animal Anil Kumar Rathaur And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172714577/
1 Husbandry for giving vaccination to the cattle, as the regular payment was not being paid to the revisionists by the private respondent, they denied to work under their control, therefore, later on,
on the basis of incorrect facts, F.I.R in question was lodged with the allegation that they were engaging themselves as veterinary doctor in the area but neither any villager made complaint nor his statement was recorded by the Investigating officer and charge sheet was filed in the most mechanical manner for the offence under Section 420 I.P.C.

entities.text: Animal Anil Kumar Rathaur And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that discharge application was filed before the court below with the specific avernment that neither any date, time and place of incident nor the victims have been disclosed.

He further submits that no offence under Section 420 I.P.C. is made out but the learned court below rejected the discharge application in the most mechanical manner, therefore, indulgence of this Court is necessary.

4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer of the revisionist but he does not dispute this fact that in the discharge application, it is mentioned that Investigating Officer has not disclosed any date, time and place of incident.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and going through the contents of the application, impugned order as well as application for discharge, it is evident that in the discharge application, it is mentioned that the date, time and place was not disclosed by the Investigating Officer but this fact was not considered by the learned court below, therefore, with the consent of the parties, order dated 12.6.2023 is hereby set aside and the criminal revision is allowed.
6.
Learned court below is directed to consider and pass fresh order on the discharge application of the revisionist.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Gaurav/-
